about_the_game:
Yooca: Sprint Fury is a fast-paced online multiplayer cycling race where strategy and timing matter as much as speed.
Race with up to eight players in short, high-intensity sprints. Draft behind opponents to gain momentum, time your sprint perfectly, and unleash your energy for that final explosive finish.

Choose your rider, customize your bike, and climb the leaderboards to prove you’re the fastest sprinter on two wheels. Compete with friends in casual races or push yourself in ranked events for global bragging rights.

Key Features

  • ⚡ Online multiplayer races (up to 8 players)

  • 🚴 Realistic drafting & energy mechanics that reward timing and tactics

  • 🧢 Bike and rider customization

  • 🏆 Leaderboards and seasonal events

Whether you’re a competitive racer or just looking for a quick adrenaline rush with friends, Yooca: Sprint Fury brings cycling action to life — every sprint counts, every millisecond matters.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows® 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 10th Gen or higher / AMD Ryzen 5 3600 or higher
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia RTX 1060 or higher / AMD Radeon RX 580 or higher
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any sound card (eg. built-in)
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows® 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 11th Gen or higher / AMD Ryzen 5 5600G or higher
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia RTX 3050 or higher / AMD Radeon 6500XT or higher
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any sound card (eg. built-in)
